chunks: Sufficient is Allah as a Disposer of affairs.
And eat of what Allah has provided for you as lawful and good.
And fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered.
ai.seo_question: What are the Quranic criteria for lawful and pure sustenance in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes these verses to underscore the Imamate as the guarantor of divine sustenance, linking material provision with spiritual purity. This triad establishes that true *taqwa* is not merely ritualistic but requires conscious adherence to the Imam’s guidance in both consumption and accountability before the Day of Judgment.
